english.title: Permit use of premises as a brothel
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the tenant or occupier or person in charge of premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), knowingly permitted the whole or part of the premises to be used as a brothel.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 35(1) of and Schedule 2 to the Sexual Offences Act 1956.
